en-US.author: Florian Heidenreich
en-US.description: The universal tag editor and more...
en-US.longDescription:
Mp3tag is a powerful and easy-to-use tool to edit metadata of audio files.
It supports batch tag-editing of ID3v1, ID3v2.3, ID3v2.4, iTunes MP4, WMA, Vorbis Comments and APE Tags for multiple files at once covering a variety of audio formats.
Furthermore, it supports online database lookups from, e.g., Discogs, MusicBrainz or freedb, allowing you to automatically gather proper tags and download cover art for your music library.
You can rename files based on the tag information, replace characters or words in tags and filenames, import/export tag information, create playlists and more.
en-US.name: Mp3tag
en-US.releaseNotes:
CHG: consolidated Tag Sources dialog captions and headers. (#72024)
FIX: potential crash when retrieving localized date and time from timestamps with very long results.
CHG: added complete support for keyboard navigation at Tag Sources settings dialogs incl. window scrolling. (#72017)
CHG: improved compatibility of builtin CSV export template. (#72011)
CHG: improved visibility of focus rect of checkbox controls when using dark mode. (#72012)
NEW: added support for preserving modified Tag Sources search input when navigating back. (#72008)
CHG: changed Tag Sources search dialog to be resizable. (#72007)
CHG: removed margin reserved for Tag Panel field labels when only fields of type Check are used for a row when docked vertically.
FIX: labels in the Tag Sources search dialog were partially clipped at the bottom for some characters.
CHG: changed cover preview button at Tag Sources query results dialog to also be enabled if full cover URL but no thumbnail URL is provided. (#71973)
CHG: changed Tag Sources query results list to preserve aspect ratio for non-square cover thumbnails. (#71974)
FIX: selection highlight in dark mode showed white rectangle which made text unreadable in recent version of Windows 11. (#71965)
CHG: skipped capitalization of Tag Source name in release link label at Tag Sources result dialog. (#71956)
CHG: many improvements to configuring different kinds of Tag Panel fields.
FIX: filtered `_format` and `_heading` which appeared in the format string helper menu after fields of that kind were added to the Tag Panel.
FIX: regression where custom field values were not always made available in the Tag Panel fields (since v3.37-beta.1).
NEW: added support for read-only information fields to Tag Panel via `_FORMAT` field and a user-defined format string. (#57009)
NEW: added support for headings to Tag Panel via `_HEADING` field.
CHG: changed shortcuts to add and remove history entries to Shift+Ctrl+Return and Shift+Ctrl+Del. (#60573)
CHG: added internal mapping for `MUSICBRAINZ_COMPOSERID`. (#71933)
FIX: crash when hovering over cover previews in Tag Sources results that could leave the lookup unresponsive.
CHG: adjusted minimal Tag Panel width to allow for more narrow sizes. (#53486)
NEW: added support for mapped metadata from MP4 `keys` atoms.
FIX: prevented flickering when toggling the Filter while matching files are selected.
NEW: added support for direct text input at converter 'Text file - Tag'. (#71791)
NEW: added live preview to converter converter 'Text file - Tag'.
LNG: updated Brazilian Portuguese, Bulgarian, Catalan, Italian, Slovak, Spanish, and Traditional Chinese translations.

zh-CN.author: Florian Heidenreich
zh-CN.description: 通用标签编辑器，以及更多……
zh-CN.longDescription:
Mp3tag 是一款功能强大、简单易用的音频文件元数据编辑工具。
支持批量编辑 ID3v1、ID3v2.3、ID3v2.4、iTunes MP4、WMA、Vorbis Comment 和 APE Tags，一次可编辑多个文件，涵盖+多种音频格式。
此外，它还支持从 Discogs、MusicBrainz 或 freedb 等在线数据库查找，让你可以自动收集适当的标签，并为你的音乐库下载封面。
你可以根据标签信息重新命名文件，替换标签和文件名中的字符或单词，导入/导出标签信息，创建播放列表等。
zh-CN.name: Mp3tag
